description: Mechanism experiment on the canonical M0-A configuration (q_near, a=0.50, K=100, T=30). Not a parameter optimization: alpha is varied over a pre-declared set to test whether correction strength only changes the time scale along one fixed deterministic state path.

metric.primary: U(t) = sum_{i=1}^{K} (p_i(t) - 1/K)^2  (histogram squared-L2 distance; identical to docs/M0_MODEL.md)
